opener: Father, I come to You exhausted from carrying what was never mine to carry alone.
lines: I release every outcome I've been gripping so tight my hands have gone numb.
Where I have labored in my own strength, fill the gap with Yours.
Where I have waited in fear, replace it with a peace that doesn't need an explanation.
ctaLine: Save this. Share this. Someone you know is carrying the exact same weight today.
